[[File:Theedcounciltrophy.jpg|thumb|250px|Trophy given by [[Theed Council/Legends|Theed Council]] in [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] quarters onboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]].]]

The '''Theed Council trophy''' was a prize awarded to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during his time serving as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
It was awarded to him by the [[Theed Council/Legends|Theed Council]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. When Palpatine became [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]], he kept onto the statue and took it as well as several other statues with him to the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].
